title: Muzaffarpur Food Processing: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
## What the business actually is
**A Muzaffarpur food processor buys a perishable farm input, converts it within days, and sells into a thin-margin wholesale chain.** Dairy, flour and corn milling, and frozen or packaged foods dominate; the asset is a plant plus cold storage, and the cash cycle is short on the output side but long on the input side because farmers and mandis want cash. **Value sits in the cold chain and the brand, not the plant** — peers show this: Milky Mist lifted EBITDA margin to 15.17% on value-added dairy [4], while Dodla ran a 5.4% EBITDA margin on largely liquid milk [6]. So when a proposal lands, check the product mix first; if it is plain liquid milk or loose flour, ask what stops the margin sliding to Dodla's level.

## What has changed now
**Bihar's GST collections fell 0.1% Apr-to-date against India's +6.1% [D], so local demand and compliance are both soft.** Against that, electricity demand in Bihar rose 14.1% Apr-to-date versus India's +9.5% [D] — more load, likely more processing capacity running. **The local pipeline is real but early:** 38 units were cleared in eight months [1], and the cabinet has opened 266 acres at the Motipur sugar mill site for industry [2]. Neither source names food processing specifically, and neither gives investment or employment figures — collect from customer. **Food-safety enforcement is live:** raids in Patna and Muzaffarpur found stale chicken and expired stock in restaurants [3].

## Where to grow
**Pursue existing small dairy and grain processors with a brand and a cold room, and units supplying institutional buyers.** Peer evidence supports the segment: Milky Mist revenue rose 42% to Rs 1,089.4 crore with PAT up 175% to Rs 75 crore [4]; Dodla revenue rose 17.4% to INR1,196 crore [6]; Foods & Inns frozen food volume grew about 39% [7] (that call is from November 2025, a year old). **Avoid new greenfield units at Motipur until allotment letters and a power sanction exist**, and avoid anyone with a food-safety notice.

## How to lend safely
**Structure against the input cycle, not the plant.** Take monthly GST returns and a stock-and-cold-storage statement; if GST turnover trails the stock build for two months, ask for the sales register. **Covenant on food-safety licence validity and on packaging cost** — Dodla's packaging material cost rose 41.6% YoY [6]. Rating reports flag raw-material and agro-climatic swings as the core margin risk [8][9].

## Early warning
- GST filings (monthly): two missed returns -> freeze fresh limits.
- Electricity bill (monthly): a drop against the 14.1% state trend [D] -> ask about idle capacity.
- Cold-storage temperature and stock logs (monthly): spoilage or stock older than shelf life -> inspect.
- Food-safety inspection report (quarterly): any adverse notice [3] -> stop disbursement.
